Every feature uses observations dated on or before signal_date. The earliest backtest execution date is trade_date_next.
PIT_Monthly and PIT_Daily_Core are inputs. Monthly_Labels contains future outcomes and must only be used as dependent variables.
All prices are standardized to USD per foreign currency. Positive returns always mean that the non-USD currency appreciated.
usd_basket_mom_3m is the negative equal-weight mean of nine foreign-currency momentum values. Positive values mean broad USD strength.
The source lacks vendor timestamps, historical index constituents, revision vintages and time-zone metadata. Transformation-PIT is certified; source-vintage PIT is not.
Historical continuation frequencies and following-return distributions for cross-sectional winners, own-currency trends and the broad USD trend.
Compares equities + VIX + WTI with a nested model that also includes US HY OAS. This is an incremental-information screen, not a final test.
Recommended month-end modeling input with technical signals and credit, equity, rates, volatility, oil and USD-index regime variables.
Forward 1-week, 1-month, 2-month and 3-month returns and cross-sectional excess returns, beginning on the next observation.
Daily core price and momentum panel for custom sampling, event windows or higher-frequency tests. Full technical indicators remain in PIT_Monthly.
Start date, end date, missingness and usable observations for each currency and market driver.
Column definitions, units, direction and PIT treatment.
The dataset uses the precise labels US HY OAS, US IG OAS and CDX. It does not call a US high-yield spread a global credit-risk factor.
PIT_Monthly retains SPX, VIX, WTI, MOVE, rates and credit variables for nested-model and orthogonalization tests.
cs_rank / cs_bucket measure cross-sectional momentum; ts_signal measures own-currency time-series momentum; usd_basket_mom measures the broad USD trend.
Conditional Summary reports the historical continuation frequency and following-return distribution under each stated condition.
Growth, Inflation, Positioning and Macro Surprise are excluded because their release dates, revision vintages or intraday timestamps are not documented.
21 / 63 / 252 FX observations. The 12-to-1-month signal skips the latest 21 observations.
The final available FX observation in each calendar month.
Equity, credit, rates and commodity variables use the latest same-day or earlier value, carried forward for at most five FX observations and never backfilled.
Only the immediately preceding FX quote may be carried forward, and the age is explicitly flagged by spot_age_days in PIT_Monthly.
